categoryDescription: Unrelated original writing - Quantum Field Theory vs Volcanology

sourceDocuments.title: Topological Invariants and Quantum Invariance
sourceDocuments.text: Topological quantum field theories compute topological invariants of manifolds using path integrals over gauge fields invariant under arbitrary diffeomorphism transformations.

studentDocument.title: Stratospheric Consequences of Subduction Volcanism
studentDocument.text: Volcanic eruptions along convergent plate boundaries release significant quantities of sulfur dioxide into the upper stratosphere, producing sulfate aerosol layers that reflect solar irradiance.
